title: 伊泰普水電站
summary: 以十二個概念任務串起水量、水力能、旋轉機械與雙頻電網介面。
summaryEn: Twelve conceptual tasks connect water balance, hydraulic energy, rotating machinery and two-frequency grid interfaces.
scope: 以伊泰普為案例的公開原理課程；所有自設數字均標為教學假設。三階段十二步不是實際施工順序、完整設備製造 SOP 或水門／送電操作指示。
scopeEn: A public-principles course using Itaipu as its case. All invented numbers are labeled teaching assumptions. Three stages and twelve steps are not a construction sequence, complete manufacturing SOP, or gate/energization instructions.

stages.title: 水力邊界與介面
stages.description: 先把水、能量與責任邊界分開。
stages.descriptionEn: First separate water, energy and responsibility boundaries.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 劃定雙國電站系統邊界
steps.objective: 分清電站、輸電與兩國電網的責任。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate plant, transmission and national-grid responsibilities.
steps.instruction: 畫出水庫、機組、變壓器與兩國電網四類節點；用不同箭頭標示水流及電力。
steps.instructionEn: Draw reservoir, generating-unit, transformer and national-grid nodes; distinguish water and electricity arrows.
steps.observation: 同一水力來源可以對接不同電力系統。
steps.observationEn: One hydraulic resource can interface with different power systems.
steps.failure: 把國界當作物理能量終點，會遺漏輸電介面。
steps.failureEn: Treating the border as an energy endpoint omits transmission interfaces.
steps.check: 逐一標出每條跨邊界箭頭的輸入、輸出與負責者。
steps.checkEn: Identify the input, output and owner of every boundary-crossing arrow.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 系統邊界決定哪些功率、損失與責任需要計入。
knowledge.textEn: System boundaries determine which powers, losses and responsibilities must be counted.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 雙國所有權與電氣連接方式是兩個不同層次的問題。
knowledge.textEn: Binational ownership and electrical connection are different layers of the system.

quiz.question: 哪個圖最適合進行介面審查？
quiz.questionEn: Which diagram best supports interface review?
options: 同時標示物理流向與各介面責任
只畫國旗與總裝置容量
把所有輸出合併成沒有單位的箭頭
optionsEn: It shows physical flows and interface responsibilities
It shows only flags and installed capacity
It combines outputs into an arrow without units
quiz.explanation: 系統邊界決定哪些功率、損失與責任需要計入。 雙國所有權與電氣連接方式是兩個不同層次的問題。
quiz.explanationEn: System boundaries determine which powers, losses and responsibilities must be counted. Binational ownership and electrical connection are different layers of the system.

steps.title: 分辨毛水頭與有效水頭
steps.objective: 說明水位差與可用水力能的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the relationship between elevation difference and usable hydraulic energy.
steps.instruction: 在自畫剖面標出上游、下游水位與管路損失；用假設的 10 單位水頭減去 2 單位損失。
steps.instructionEn: Mark upstream and downstream levels and conduit losses; subtract an assumed loss of 2 from a gross head of 10 units.
steps.observation: 有效水頭為 8 個示例單位，不能再把損失扣第二次。
steps.observationEn: Effective head is 8 example units; losses must not be subtracted twice.
steps.failure: 直接把壩體高度當有效水頭，會混淆結構尺度與水力條件。
steps.failureEn: Using dam height as effective head confuses structural dimensions with hydraulic conditions.
steps.check: 指出兩個水位基準，並保留損失的計算位置。
steps.checkEn: Identify both level references and show where losses enter the calculation.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 可用水頭取決於上下游能量差及沿途損失。
knowledge.textEn: Usable head depends on the upstream–downstream energy difference and intervening losses.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 示例單位只用來練習能量帳，不是伊泰普的實際水頭。
knowledge.textEn: The example units teach energy accounting; they are not Itaipu’s actual head.

quiz.question: 例子中應採用多少有效水頭？
quiz.questionEn: What effective head should the example use?
optionsEn: A value determined solely by dam height
quiz.explanation: 可用水頭取決於上下游能量差及沿途損失。 示例單位只用來練習能量帳，不是伊泰普的實際水頭。
quiz.explanationEn: Usable head depends on the upstream–downstream energy difference and intervening losses. The example units teach energy accounting; they are not Itaipu’s actual head.

steps.title: 閉合水量收支
steps.objective: 檢查入流、出流與庫存變化是否相容。
steps.objectiveEn: Check whether inflow, outflow and storage change are consistent.
steps.instruction: 建立假設一小時帳：入流 12、發電用水 8、其他出流 3，全部採同一體積單位。
steps.instructionEn: Create an assumed one-hour account: inflow 12, turbine discharge 8 and other outflow 3, all in one volume unit.
steps.observation: 庫存增加 1 單位；用水並未因發電而消失。
steps.observationEn: Storage increases by 1 unit; generation does not destroy the water.
steps.failure: 忽略其他出流會高估庫存增加，進而誤判可用水量。
steps.failureEn: Omitting other outflow overstates storage growth and available water.
steps.check: 驗證入流減總出流等於庫存變化，並註明時間窗。
steps.checkEn: Verify that inflow minus total outflow equals storage change and state the time window.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 守恆帳必須同時包含流量路徑與儲存項。
knowledge.textEn: A conservation account includes both flow paths and storage.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 瞬時流量與一段時間的總體積不能直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: An instantaneous flow rate cannot be subtracted directly from a time-integrated volume.

quiz.question: 這一小時庫存如何改變？
quiz.questionEn: How does storage change during this hour?
quiz.explanation: 守恆帳必須同時包含流量路徑與儲存項。 瞬時流量與一段時間的總體積不能直接相減。
quiz.explanationEn: A conservation account includes both flow paths and storage. An instantaneous flow rate cannot be subtracted directly from a time-integrated volume.

steps.title: 追蹤壓力管與機組介面
steps.objective: 識別水力、結構與維修介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify hydraulic, structural and maintenance interfaces.
steps.instruction: 在概念圖依序連接進水口、壓力管、水輪機與尾水；另畫承重與檢修邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Connect intake, penstock, turbine and tailwater on a concept diagram; add support and maintenance boundaries.
steps.observation: 水路連續不代表支承與隔離責任已經完整。
steps.observationEn: A continuous water path does not by itself define support or isolation responsibilities.
steps.failure: 只檢查管徑接得上，會漏掉位移、載荷與可維護性。
steps.failureEn: Checking only matching pipe sizes misses displacement, load and maintainability.
steps.check: 為每個介面列一項幾何資料與一項需由專業團隊確認的載荷資料。
steps.checkEn: List one geometry item and one professionally reviewed load item for each interface.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 設備介面同時傳遞物質、力與資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Equipment interfaces carry matter, forces and information.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 此圖用來辨識資料缺口，不授權開關水門或拆卸受壓部件。
knowledge.textEn: The diagram identifies missing information; it does not authorize gate operation or disassembly of pressurized components.

quiz.question: 哪項資訊不能因水路連通而省略？
quiz.questionEn: Which information cannot be omitted merely because the water path connects?
options: 支承載荷與維修隔離邊界
optionsEn: Support loads and maintenance isolation boundaries
quiz.explanation: 設備介面同時傳遞物質、力與資訊。 此圖用來辨識資料缺口，不授權開關水門或拆卸受壓部件。
quiz.explanationEn: Equipment interfaces carry matter, forces and information. The diagram identifies missing information; it does not authorize gate operation or disassembly of pressurized components.

stages.title: 機電能量轉換
stages.description: 把水輪機、軸、發電機及頻率需求連起來。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect turbine, shaft, generator and frequency requirements.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 連接水輪機與發電機能量帳
steps.titleEn: Connect turbine and generator energy accounts
steps.objective: 把水力功率分解為軸功率與電功率。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate hydraulic power into shaft and electrical power.
steps.instruction: 用假設水力輸入 100、軸輸出 90、電輸出 85 個功率單位畫出三段能量帳。
steps.instructionEn: Draw three energy stages with assumed hydraulic input 100, shaft output 90 and electrical output 85 power units.
steps.observation: 水輪機損失 10、發電機損失 5；總效率為 85%。
steps.observationEn: Turbine loss is 10 and generator loss is 5; overall efficiency is 85%.
steps.failure: 相加各段效率會得到沒有物理意義的總效率。
steps.failureEn: Adding stage efficiencies produces a physically meaningless overall efficiency.
steps.check: 核對輸入等於有效輸出加所有損失，並說明效率應相乘。
steps.checkEn: Check input against useful output plus losses and explain why stage efficiencies multiply.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 串聯能量轉換的總效率是各段效率的乘積。
knowledge.textEn: Overall efficiency of serial energy conversion is the product of stage efficiencies.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 例子的數值是學習用假設，不是廠商保證值。
knowledge.textEn: The numbers are teaching assumptions, not vendor guarantees.

quiz.question: 例子的水力到電力總效率是多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is the example’s hydraulic-to-electrical efficiency?
quiz.explanation: 串聯能量轉換的總效率是各段效率的乘積。 例子的數值是學習用假設，不是廠商保證值。
quiz.explanationEn: Overall efficiency of serial energy conversion is the product of stage efficiencies. The numbers are teaching assumptions, not vendor guarantees.

steps.title: 分組 50 Hz 與 60 Hz 電氣介面
steps.titleEn: Group 50 Hz and 60 Hz electrical interfaces
steps.objective: 理解伊泰普機組分組為何需要電網介面規劃。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why Itaipu’s unit groups need deliberate grid interfaces.
steps.instruction: 依官方資料把二十部機組卡分成十部 50 Hz 與十部 60 Hz；把各組接到相應頻率標籤。
steps.instructionEn: Use the official account to sort twenty unit cards into ten 50 Hz and ten 60 Hz units, then match frequency labels.
steps.observation: 同樣的容量單位不表示兩種頻率可直接並聯。
steps.observationEn: Identical power units do not imply that different frequencies can be directly paralleled.
steps.failure: 把容量相等誤當同步條件，會漏掉頻率與相位相容性。
steps.failureEn: Treating equal capacity as synchronization overlooks frequency and phase compatibility.
steps.check: 在任何跨頻率連線旁標記需要明確轉換介面，而非直接電線。
steps.checkEn: Mark every cross-frequency link as requiring a defined conversion interface, not a direct wire.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 交流並聯系統需要相容的頻率、相位與電壓條件。
knowledge.textEn: Parallel AC systems require compatible frequency, phase and voltage conditions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本步只辨識介面；不提供實際送電或同步操作指令。
knowledge.textEn: This task identifies interfaces only; it gives no energization or synchronization instructions.

quiz.question: 50 Hz 與 60 Hz 標籤的主要工程意義為何？
quiz.questionEn: What is the main engineering implication of the 50 Hz and 60 Hz labels?
options: 只要功率相同即可直接相連
表示兩種水的流動速度
必須審查跨系統的頻率相容與轉換
optionsEn: Equal power alone permits direct connection
Cross-system frequency compatibility and conversion need review
quiz.explanation: 交流並聯系統需要相容的頻率、相位與電壓條件。 本步只辨識介面；不提供實際送電或同步操作指令。
quiz.explanationEn: Parallel AC systems require compatible frequency, phase and voltage conditions. This task identifies interfaces only; it gives no energization or synchronization instructions.

steps.title: 辨識扭矩與轉速的角色
steps.titleEn: Identify the roles of torque and speed
steps.objective: 區分旋轉機械的運動與傳能量。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish rotational motion from mechanical energy transfer.
steps.instruction: 比較兩個假設軸工況：相同轉速、不同扭矩；用 P=Tω 標示功率比例。
steps.instructionEn: Compare two assumed shaft cases at equal speed but different torque; use P=Tω to mark the power ratio.
steps.observation: 轉速相同時，扭矩加倍會使軸功率加倍。
steps.observationEn: At equal speed, doubling torque doubles shaft power.
steps.failure: 把轉速直接當作功率讀值，會忽略負載變化。
steps.failureEn: Using speed alone as a power reading ignores changes in load.
steps.check: 列出扭矩、角速度與功率的不同單位。
steps.checkEn: List distinct units for torque, angular speed and power.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 軸功率同時取決於扭矩與角速度。
knowledge.textEn: Shaft power depends on both torque and angular speed.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 此比例比較不需要也不代表真實機組的額定軸參數。
knowledge.textEn: The ratio comparison neither needs nor represents real rated shaft parameters.

quiz.question: 相同轉速下，哪項變化會增加軸功率？
quiz.questionEn: At the same speed, which change increases shaft power?
quiz.explanation: 軸功率同時取決於扭矩與角速度。 此比例比較不需要也不代表真實機組的額定軸參數。
quiz.explanationEn: Shaft power depends on both torque and angular speed. The ratio comparison neither needs nor represents real rated shaft parameters.

steps.title: 畫出調節與回授概念
steps.objective: 分開量測、設定與致動的訊號路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate measurement, setpoint and actuation signal paths.
steps.instruction: 建立紙上控制方塊圖：假設目標功率、量測功率、誤差比較與水量調節；加入延遲方塊。
steps.instructionEn: Build a paper block diagram with assumed target power, measured power, error comparison, water regulation and a delay block.
steps.observation: 量測與致動延遲能讓同一設定產生不同暫態。
steps.observationEn: Measurement and actuation delays can produce different transients for the same target.
steps.failure: 看到誤差就假定設備立即到位，會錯過振盪與過度調節。
steps.failureEn: Assuming instantaneous response to error misses oscillation and overcorrection.
steps.check: 以箭頭區分能量流與回授訊號，並圈出尚未建模的延遲。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish energy and feedback arrows and circle unmodelled delays.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 回授根據量測與目標的差異修正動作，實際系統具有動態。
knowledge.textEn: Feedback adjusts action from measured error, while real systems have dynamics.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本課不給控制器增益；有效增益需要設備模型及正式驗證。
knowledge.textEn: No controller gains are supplied; valid gains require equipment models and formal verification.

quiz.question: 哪個方塊不能由「理想即時反應」取代？
quiz.questionEn: Which block should not be replaced by an assumption of instant response?
quiz.explanation: 回授根據量測與目標的差異修正動作，實際系統具有動態。 本課不給控制器增益；有效增益需要設備模型及正式驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Feedback adjusts action from measured error, while real systems have dynamics. No controller gains are supplied; valid gains require equipment models and formal verification.

stages.title: 證據與交接
stages.description: 用量綱、可用率與可追溯資料完成概念審查。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete a conceptual review using dimensions, availability and traceability.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 區別容量、功率與電量
steps.objective: 避免把 MW 與 MWh 混為一談。
steps.instruction: 對假設平均輸出 2 MW、持續 3 小時的機組計算電量，並另列裝置容量欄。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate energy for an assumed average output of 2 MW over 3 hours and keep installed capacity in a separate field.
steps.observation: 電量為 6 MWh；裝置容量不等於每小時必達的輸出。
steps.observationEn: Energy is 6 MWh; installed capacity is not an hourly output guarantee.
steps.failure: 直接把官方容量當年電量，會造成量綱錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Treating official capacity as annual energy causes a dimensional error.
steps.check: 確認每個值均有單位與時間範圍，並標示假設平均值。
steps.checkEn: Check units and time ranges and label the assumed average.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 電量是功率對時間的累積。
knowledge.textEn: Energy is power accumulated over time.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 官方年度產量應連同年份閱讀，不能當作永久固定值。
knowledge.textEn: Official annual generation belongs to its stated year, not a permanent fixed output.

quiz.question: 示例產生多少電量？
quiz.questionEn: How much energy does the example produce?
quiz.explanation: 電量是功率對時間的累積。 官方年度產量應連同年份閱讀，不能當作永久固定值。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy is power accumulated over time. Official annual generation belongs to its stated year, not a permanent fixed output.

steps.title: 分開效率與可用率
steps.objective: 判斷同樣高效的設備為何年度輸出仍不同。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why equally efficient equipment can have different annual outputs.
steps.instruction: 用假設機組 A 與 B：運轉效率相同，但可用時數分別為 8 與 6；在相同平均功率下比較電量。
steps.instructionEn: Compare assumed units A and B with equal operating efficiency but 8 and 6 available hours at the same average power.
steps.observation: 停機時數改變電量，即使運轉期間效率不變。
steps.observationEn: Downtime changes energy output even when operating efficiency is unchanged.
steps.failure: 只報最佳效率會掩蓋停機與維修造成的交付差異。
steps.failureEn: Reporting only peak efficiency hides delivery differences caused by outages and maintenance.
steps.check: 把損失帳與可用時數帳分成兩張表。

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 效率描述運轉時的能量轉換，可用率描述可服務時間比例。
knowledge.textEn: Efficiency describes energy conversion while operating; availability describes the fraction of serviceable time.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 年度比較還要控制來水條件，不能把所有差異都歸因於維修。
knowledge.textEn: Annual comparisons also need inflow context; not every difference is caused by maintenance.

quiz.question: 哪一項可直接解釋示例兩機組的電量差異？
quiz.questionEn: What directly explains the example’s energy difference?
quiz.explanation: 效率描述運轉時的能量轉換，可用率描述可服務時間比例。 年度比較還要控制來水條件，不能把所有差異都歸因於維修。
quiz.explanationEn: Efficiency describes energy conversion while operating; availability describes the fraction of serviceable time. Annual comparisons also need inflow context; not every difference is caused by maintenance.

steps.title: 建立異常證據的關聯圖
steps.objective: 用多個觀察量區分假設故障。
steps.objectiveEn: Use multiple observations to separate hypothetical faults.
steps.instruction: 設計兩張虛構事件卡：功率下降但水頭不變，以及水頭下降且功率下降；列出下一個需核對的量測。
steps.instructionEn: Create two fictional event cards: falling power with steady head, and falling head with falling power; list the next measurement to check.
steps.observation: 相同功率症狀可能來自不同上游條件。
steps.observationEn: The same power symptom can arise from different upstream conditions.
steps.failure: 只憑單一曲線宣判機組損壞，會把外部條件當成內部故障。
steps.failureEn: Declaring damage from one curve can mistake an external condition for an internal fault.
steps.check: 每個判斷附上證據、替代解釋與未確認項，不自行解除保護。
steps.checkEn: Attach evidence, alternatives and unknowns to each judgment without overriding protections.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 故障診斷需要一致的時間基準及多訊號交叉檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Fault diagnosis needs aligned timestamps and cross-checking of multiple signals.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 事件卡是教學假設，並非電站事故紀錄或處置命令。
knowledge.textEn: The event cards are teaching assumptions, not plant incident records or response orders.

quiz.question: 單一功率下降曲線能確定什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What can a single falling-power curve establish?
options: 輸出下降，原因仍需其他證據
optionsEn: Output fell; its cause still needs other evidence
quiz.explanation: 故障診斷需要一致的時間基準及多訊號交叉檢查。 事件卡是教學假設，並非電站事故紀錄或處置命令。
quiz.explanationEn: Fault diagnosis needs aligned timestamps and cross-checking of multiple signals. The event cards are teaching assumptions, not plant incident records or response orders.

steps.title: 完成機電系統概念交接
steps.objective: 把守恆、電網介面與驗證缺口合成可審查文件。
steps.objectiveEn: Combine conservation accounts, grid interfaces and evidence gaps into a reviewable package.
steps.instruction: 提交一頁系統圖、兩張水量／能量帳、頻率分組表及三項待查證問題。
steps.instructionEn: Submit a one-page system diagram, water and energy accounts, a frequency-group table and three unresolved questions.
steps.observation: 不同表格使用同一邊界與時間基準時，結論才可互相比較。
steps.observationEn: Conclusions become comparable when the tables share boundaries and time bases.
steps.failure: 刪除假設標籤會讓教學計算看似正式設計。
steps.failureEn: Removing assumption labels makes teaching calculations look like formal design.
steps.check: 為每張圖列來源與假設，並由另一位學徒重新核算一個量綱。
steps.checkEn: Label sources and assumptions and ask another learner to recheck one dimensional calculation.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 交接品質取決於可追溯的假設、介面與驗證證據。
knowledge.textEn: Handover quality depends on traceable assumptions, interfaces and verification evidence.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 完成課程表示通過概念審查，不表示有權建造或操作水電站。
knowledge.textEn: Course completion means passing a conceptual review, not authorization to construct or operate a plant.

quiz.question: 哪份交接資料最可審查？
quiz.questionEn: Which handover package is most reviewable?
options: 只列總容量且沒有邊界
把所有假設改寫為實測值
保留來源、單位、假設及未解問題
optionsEn: It retains sources, units, assumptions and open questions
quiz.explanation: 交接品質取決於可追溯的假設、介面與驗證證據。 完成課程表示通過概念審查，不表示有權建造或操作水電站。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover quality depends on traceable assumptions, interfaces and verification evidence. Course completion means passing a conceptual review, not authorization to construct or operate a plant.
